note: Both sets hallucinate span positions not on the x-axis (e.g., 47%, 85%) and misinterpret the '54%' axis label as a thickness value. However, Set B is better because it correctly identifies several 'total thickness' values (e.g., 44mm at 15%) that match the chart's total bar height, whereas Set A frequently misattributes these total heights to the 'glass_biax' layer (e.g., claiming 42mm glass_biax thickness). Set B also has fewer invented span percentages and misread labels compared to Set A.
